aligner.name: aligner
aligner.input: reference index in FASTA/FASTQ or minimap2 .mmi format, plus reads file or directory (any HTS format, optionally searched recursively)
aligner.output: alignment files equivalent to minimap2 output (typically BAM), with optional summary file
aligner.description: Alignment tool using minimap2 with lr:hq‑like presets. Produces alignments equivalent to minimap2, supporting directory recursion, BED‑based overlap counting and optional summary generation.

basecaller.name: basecaller
basecaller.input: POD5 files (can recursively scan directories, optionally filter by read IDs or limit number of reads)
basecaller.output: FASTQ or SAM format basecalled sequences
basecaller.description: Performs basecalling on raw nanopore sequencing data from POD5 files. Converts electrical signal data into nucleotide sequences in FASTQ or SAM format. Supports quality filtering, read splitting, and resume functionality.

correct.name: correct
correct.input: FASTQ reads file to correct, with optional PAF alignment file and correction model path
correct.output: corrected reads in FASTA/FASTQ format or PAF alignments depending on options
correct.description: Read correction tool for nanopore sequencing data. Uses alignment information and a neural correction model to improve read accuracy, optionally generating only PAF alignments or full corrected sequences.

demux.name: demux
demux.input: HTS reads file or a directory containing reads (any HTS format, optionally searched recursively)
demux.output: demultiplexed per-barcode read files (BAM by default, optional FASTQ) and optional summary file
demux.description: Barcode demultiplexing tool. Splits reads into separate outputs by barcode using a specified barcoding kit or sample sheet, with options for custom barcode arrangements and sequences.

download.name: download
download.input: optional POD5 data files for automatic model selection
download.output: basecalling model files in specified directory
download.description: Downloads basecalling models from the internet. Can list available models, download specific models or all models, and optionally use POD5 data to automatically select appropriate models.

polish.name: polish
polish.input: aligned reads in BAM format and a draft assembly in FASTA/FASTQ format
polish.output: polished consensus assembly (FASTx) and optional VCF/gVCF variant files
polish.description: Consensus polishing tool for improving draft assemblies using aligned nanopore reads. Produces a polished assembly and optionally variant and gVCF outputs, with tunable windowing and depth/quality thresholds.

summary.name: summary
summary.input: SAM/BAM file produced by dorado basecaller
summary.description: Generates summary statistics from basecalled SAM/BAM files. Provides read-level and overall sequencing statistics from dorado basecaller output.

trim.name: trim
trim.input: reads file(s) to trim in any HTS format
trim.output: adapter/primer-trimmed reads in BAM by default or FASTQ if requested
trim.description: Adapter/primer trimming tool. Detects and removes sequencing adapters and primers based on kit definitions or custom primer sequences, with options to disable primer trimming and control output format.

variant.name: variant
variant.input: aligned reads in BAM format and reference sequences in FASTA/FASTQ format
variant.output: diploid variant calls in VCF or gVCF format
variant.description: Diploid variant calling tool for nanopore data. Uses aligned reads and a neural variant model to call SNVs and small indels, with options for gVCF output, region restriction and phasing control.
